note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Description, biography and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Public organization pages only. Supply named /company/ URLs or slugs, not numeric IDs, personal profiles or search URLs. Industry and size filters select from the supplied companies; they do not search LinkedIn for new companies. linkedin_members_count counts LinkedIn profiles associated with the organization and is not payroll headcount. company_size is the published band. No employees, founder lookup, email addresses, revenue estimates or jobs.
